### appMethodSchemas()

```ts
function appMethodSchemas(api): object;
```

Compile App validators and their Standard JSON Schema descriptions. Validation
enforces both the declaration and JSON-only values; discovery describes the
declaration without adding JSON guard nesting. Agar's emitted output already
includes Pending for opted-in methods.

### appApiOperations()

```ts
function appApiOperations(name, api): readonly object[];
```

Project an already decoded Release API into discovery data with the same paths
the Agent catalog uses (`PRINTS.generate`, called as `env.PRINTS.generate()`).
The introduction owner supplies the installation's binding name; this function
grants no access and supplies no execution handler. Role aliases can project the
same API.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type     |
| --------- | -------- |
| `name`    | `string` |
| `api`     | `AppApi` |

#### Returns

readonly `object`[]

### listOperations()

```ts
function listOperations(operations, catalogStamp, rawInput): object;
```

Page a trusted immutable operation-summary view. Hosts may filter the existing
catalog to their bound operations before paging; this is the one cursor owner.
Order is namespace then full path, compared by UTF-16 code units, never locale.
Unlike search, no equivalent operations are merged into peers.

#### Parameters

| Parameter             | Type                                                                   |
| --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `operations`          | readonly `object`[]                                                    |
| `catalogStamp`        | `string`                                                               |
| `rawInput`            | \{ `cursor?`: `string`; `limit?`: `number`; `namespace?`: `string`; \} |
| `rawInput.cursor?`    | `string`                                                               |
| `rawInput.limit?`     | `number`                                                               |
| `rawInput.namespace?` | `string`                                                               |

#### Returns

`object`

| Name           | Type               |
| -------------- | ------------------ |
| `results`      | `object`[]         |
| `total`        | `number`           |
| `nextCursor`   | `string` \| `null` |
| `catalogStamp` | `string`           |
